sentences.span: NVIDIA's 3QFY27 results came in ahead of expectations, with revenue of USD 115.8bn versus consensus of USD 109.0bn and non-GAAP EPS of USD 2.68 versus USD 2.48 consensus. Data center revenue reached USD 107.6bn, up 110% y/y
sentences.why: Every figure (revenue, consensus, EPS, EPS consensus, data center revenue, y/y growth) matches exactly.

sentences.span: Guidance for the January 2027 quarter of USD 130.0bn ±3% was also comfortably above the consensus of USD 125.3bn ... management raised FY28 (January 2028) revenue growth expectations to approximately 75% from 70%
sentences.why: Guidance figure, consensus figure, and the growth-guidance raise (FY28 = next fiscal year) all match.

sentences.span: some investors have been worried about C2027 cuts, but our view has always been that this is more about how much things decelerate in C2028 ... trim C2028 a bit more (now up <10% Y/Y) with EPS now ~$18.80 ... our PT comes down only slightly to $220 and we maintain Buy
sentences.why: The 2028-growth estimate, EPS, price-target cut ($240→$220) and Buy rating are all faithful. But the sentence claims UBS's own worry 'moved from a 2027 cut to' 2028 deceleration; the source explicitly attributes the 2027-cut worry to 'some investors' and states UBS's view 'has always been' about 2028, not that it shifted there from a prior 2027 concern. This misattributes whose worry it was and inverts a 'constant' into a 'change over time.'

sentences.span: Nomura's rebalance grid shows just how lopsided the mechanics have become: options dealers, levered ETFs and vol control funds would need to sell roughly $82 billion on a 5% down day, but "only" buy about $66 billion on a 5% up day.
sentences.why: Exact match on both figures and the asymmetric framing.
